enchantments.tooltip: +8 Enhancement Bonus: +8 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Poisonous 5: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 5d6 poison damage on each hit.
Toxic 12: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 12d6 poison damage on each critical hit.
Poison Resistance +44: Passive: +44 Enhancement bonus to your Poison Resistance.

Proof Against Poison +6: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +6 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 7 + their Fortitude save).
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
